Qh: spread first in buildMechanicsConfig, under the encounter's defaults and the player's settings; the fallback of isPrayerUnlockedByMechanics: "common" is inferred

df: its values ("upgradedPrayers", "zealPrayer") are keys isPrayerUnlockedByMechanics reads from the mechanics config

wG: inferred: unless the NPC already fights the attacker and acted within 8 ticks, moves `nextActionTick` to at least half an attack speed from now; the "standard" case of the retaliation
HG: inferred: sets `retaliation.lastIncomingAttackTick` and `combat.targetId` to the attacker, by the retaliation's mode; throws "Unknown retaliation mode"

JM: inferred: twelve lists of six pairs of item ids; six pieces found give the full bonus in getGracefulBonusPercent
QM: inferred: three pairs of item ids stored with piece index 1, the cape of a graceful set
eT: getGracefulBonusPercent sums it by piece index into what the engine stores as `gracefulBonusPercent`
aT: inferred: pairs of item ids, the graceful and cape pairs among them; the second is the item whose weight counts when the first is worn
tT: inferred: the Map of those pairs; getCarriedWeight loads `tT.get(itemId) ?? itemId` for an item of the equipment
nT: filled with `set(itemId, pieceIndex)`; getGracefulBonusPercent collects the indices found among the equipment
sT: inferred: the item id getCarriedWeight loads for a worn item
iT: inferred: `params.get(paramId)` if it is a number, else the fallback
oT: inferred: partial stats by item id (`attackCrush`, `attackSpeed`, ...), spread over the stats read from the item
dT: inferred: returns the stats with the variant arrow's or the override table's values over them
gT: inferred: reads `attackStab` ... `attackRange` from an item's params and applies the overrides
cT: the param ids readEquipmentStats reads; an item with none of them takes the stats of its base item

RA: filled with `set(id, entry)` for each of an entry's `ids`; getMonsterHitpoints and getMonsterFormulaStats look an NPC type id up in it
PA: filled with the key `${id}:${entry.version}`; getMonsterFormulaStats looks up `${npcTypeId}:${version}`
